tool_executions.arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'
p='fs_test.go'
L=open(p).read().split('\n')
# lines are 1-indexed: 360 '{' and 380 '}' 
assert L[359].strip()=='{' and L[379].strip()=='}'
body=[l[1:] if l.startswith('\t\t') else l for l in L[360:379]]
body=[b.replace('t.Fatalf("crossDevice=%v: %v", crossDevice, err)','t.Fatal(err)').replace('t.Errorf("crossDevice=%v %s: got %q, want %q", crossDevice, path, got, want)','t.Errorf("%s: got %q, want %q", path, got, want)') for b in body]
L=L[:359]+body+L[380:]
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(L))
EOF
sed -i 's|^func testMoveMerges|// testMoveMerges moves a directory onto an existing one, by rename or across devices.\nfunc testMoveMerges|' fs_test.go
gofmt -l .; go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./... && TWIN_XDEV_DIR=$PWD go test -count=1 -run 'Device|Merge' -v . 2>&1 | grep -E "^(---|ok|FAIL)"; ls -a | grep twin-","description":"Flatten helper, rerun tests incl. real cross-device"}
